feed.title: UBS reiterates Deckers Outdoor stock Buy rating on brand strength
feed.summary: UBS has reiterated a Buy rating for Deckers Outdoor (NYSE:DECK) stock, setting a price target of $161.00. The firm expects strong revenue growth from the Hoka and UGG brands to drive positive surprises, projecting high-single-digit sales growth and low-double-digit EPS growth over five years. Despite some analyst concerns about demand and competition, UBS views Deckers Outdoor as an undervalued growth company.

feed.title: Adobe Pulls Back, Then Recovers as CEO Handoff Meets Soft Q4 Outlook; Intuit and ServiceNow Hold Steady
feed.summary: Adobe experienced a stock wobble despite beating Q3 estimates and raising its full-year outlook, primarily due to a soft Q4 revenue guidance and simultaneous CEO and CFO transitions. While Adobe's stock initially dropped 3% before recovering, peers Intuit and ServiceNow remained steady, indicating that the market reaction was specific to Adobe rather than a broader tech trend. The company's record Q3 revenue and significant AI ARR growth were overshadowed by investor unease regarding the leadership changes and conservative Q4 outlook.

feed.title: Tesla’s Trucking Business Could Unlock A $17B Software Opportunity, Morgan Stanley Says
feed.summary: Morgan Stanley suggests that Tesla's autonomous trucking software could generate $17 billion in revenue and $7.5 billion in incremental EBIT by 2040, based on a projected $500 billion to $1.1 trillion U.S. autonomous trucking market by 2041. The firm estimates that the software could yield $12,000 to $18,000 in monthly revenue per truck, assuming Tesla has 82,000 Semis on the road. Despite this potential, Tesla's shares are down over 19% year-to-date, making it the worst-performing stock among the "Magnificent 7."

feed.summary: Aramark Facilities Management's TwinOptix® platform has been recognized with the 2026 FacilitiesNet Vision Award. This award highlights the platform's innovative approach and contribution to the facilities management industry.

feed.title: $6 diesel should benefit Tesla's trucking ambitions, Morgan Stanley says
feed.summary: Surging diesel prices, which have surpassed $6 a gallon, could significantly boost the demand for Tesla's electric semi-trucks, according to Morgan Stanley analysts. An autonomous electric semi is projected to cut costs by 20% per mile and increase annual mileage by 133% compared to human-operated diesel vehicles. This could lead to a dramatic increase in profit per truck, making Tesla's trucking solution more attractive amidst rising fuel costs.

feed.title: Turn Therapeutics to Present at Stifel 2026 Virtual Immunology and Inflammation Forum

Hahn, M.D., will discuss the company's atopic dermatitis clinical program, including its pruritus-focused stage 2 enrichment strategy and findings across diverse patient populations. feed.title: TJX (TJX) Loses 17.8% in 4 Weeks, Here's Why a Trend Reversal May be Around the Corner
feed.summary: TJX (TJX) has seen a 17.8% decline in its stock price over the last four weeks, but indicators suggest a potential trend reversal. Its Relative Strength Index (RSI) of 17.78 indicates the stock is oversold, while a 0.6% increase in consensus EPS estimates for the current year, driven by analyst revisions, points to a fundamental improvement. Additionally, the stock holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), further supporting the likelihood of a near-term rebound.

feed.title: Alliance Entertainment FY 2026 slides: 8% revenue growth, 24% EPS gain
feed.summary: Alliance Entertainment (NASDAQ: AENT) reported robust fiscal year 2026 results, with an 8% revenue increase to $1.15 billion and a 24% rise in adjusted diluted EPS to $0.46, driven by strong demand for physical entertainment media and collectibles. The company's shares rallied significantly following the announcement, reflecting investor confidence in its strategic shift towards premium collectibles, authentication platforms, and technological advancements like AI and automation. While facing challenges such as negative operating cash flow due to working capital demands, Alliance Entertainment aims to continue its growth trajectory by leveraging studio partnerships, expanding its exclusive distribution network, and enhancing operational efficiency.

feed.title: REIT Alexandria Beats Investor Suit Over Property Write-Downs
feed.summary: Alexandria Real Estate Equities Inc., a life sciences landlord, has successfully defended against an investor lawsuit alleging that the company concealed weakening property values and delayed recording billions in losses. A US District Court judge dismissed the proposed class action, ruling that the plaintiff failed to sufficiently prove that the REIT's executives intentionally or recklessly misled investors. The court found that the investor did not adequately link the executives to the company's accounting analyses or impairment procedures.

feed.title: Lululemon’s newest bear sees more pain for stock after 81% rout
feed.summary: BMO Capital Markets initiated coverage on Lululemon Athletica Inc. with an "underperform" rating, citing a deeply challenged business, declining market share to rivals, and deteriorating sales in key regions. Analyst Kelly Crago believes the athletic wear company's turnaround will be difficult due to stale products, diminishing relevance among consumers, and a shift away from athleisure fashion, forecasting further stock declines and pressure on margins. Despite a new CEO, Heidi O’Neill, tasked with revitalizing the brand, BMO sees Lululemon's stock potentially bottoming at $50 given current market conditions and lack of clear turnaround visibility.

feed.title: Edwards Lifesciences stock price target maintained at $85 by Canaccord
feed.summary: Canaccord maintained a Hold rating and an $85.00 price target on Edwards Lifesciences following a Medicare coverage decision for transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) procedures. The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) formalized Medicare coverage for asymptomatic severe aortic stenosis and removed facility-level procedural volume thresholds, which is expected to drive longer-term volume growth. Despite this positive development, Canaccord notes that the implementation and adoption of the new National Coverage Determination (NCD) will take time, influencing their cautious rating.

feed.title: Edwards Lifesciences stock price target maintained at $85 by Canaccord
feed.summary: Canaccord has reiterated a Hold rating and an $85 price target for Edwards Lifesciences (NYSE:EW) after Medicare finalized coverage for transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) procedures, including those for asymptomatic severe aortic stenosis. Despite the stock trading above Canaccord's target at $86.77 and a premium valuation, 15 analysts have revised earnings downwards for the upcoming period, adding a cautious note to the Hold rating. The finalized Medicare policy is expected to be a long-term tailwind for TAVR due to formalized coverage, removal of facility volume thresholds, and increased workflow flexibility.

feed.title: NAPA Auto Parts parent company shares more details on company split
feed.summary: Genuine Parts Co., parent company of NAPA Auto Parts, has released more details regarding its plan to split its automotive and industrial businesses into two independent, publicly traded companies by Q1 2027. The automotive business will operate as Genuine Parts Co. (GPC) and the industrial business as Motion. The company has also announced key leadership appointments for both entities, with Court Carruthers becoming CEO-elect of GPC and Will Stengel serving as chairman and CEO of Motion.

feed.title: Anixa Biosciences and Nexalin Technology Interviews to Air Nationally on the RedChip Small Stocks, Big Money(TM) Show on CNBC and Bloomberg TV

The interviews will be broadcast on Bloomberg TV on September 12 and on CNBC on September 13. feed.title: Amazon vs. Alphabet: If I Could Buy Only One, I’d Choose This Stock

feed.title: Adobe Forecast Misses Estimates, Renewing Fears About AI Impact
feed.summary: Adobe Inc.'s sales forecast narrowly missed analysts' estimates, reigniting concerns among investors about the impact of AI competitors on the company. The software maker's shares dropped following the announcement, reflecting ongoing investor unease, especially given the rise of generative AI tools that offer alternatives to Adobe's traditional products. The company also announced a new CEO, Anil Chakravarthy, a decision that surprised some investors as he previously led a smaller division.

feed.title: Francisco Partners, KKR to buy minority stakes in Italy's TeamSystem, sources say

The deal values TeamSystem between EUR8 billion and EUR10 billion, allowing H&F to divest part of its investment amid a challenging market for software stocks. This transaction is seen as an encouraging sign for private equity firms with significant software holdings, demonstrating the ability to reduce stakes in major holdings through a private IPO process.

feed.title: A flag of YPF gas and oil company flutters next to an Argentine flag outside the YPF headquarters in Buenos Aires
